sources.page: Blender Manual, Shader Nodes > Shader > Principled BSDF; Material Output node
sources.section: Inputs (Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Alpha, Normal, Emission Color); Displacement
sources.facts: The consumer inputs each map feeds: colour maps (Base Color, Emission Color), scalar maps (Metallic, Roughness, Alpha), the tangent-space normal through a Normal Map node, displacement through the Material Output's Displacement.
Blender consumes the exported normal as OpenGL (+Y) tangent space, Non-Color; BaseColor sRGB; Roughness and Metallic Raw.

Files Painter wrote through this preset on an OCIO-managed UzmiGames project, in this order: <set>_BaseColor_sRGB, _Normal_Raw, _Metallic_Raw, _Roughness_Raw, _Emission_sRGB, _Alpha_Raw, _Displacement_Raw (the delivery kept the five present maps); the preset's resource URL and its version.

Delivered files named <TextureSet>_<Map>_sRGB.png or _Raw.png (for example 18-Tunica DefaultMaterial_Normal_Raw.png, 13-Grimorio Grimorio_BaseColor_sRGB.png): the colour-space suffix appears on OCIO projects.

packing.decision: Seven maps in this order, each name ending in the optional (.$udim) (empty in the Default workflow). The preset sets fileFormat, bitDepth and dithering per map and no paddingAlgorithm or sizeLog2: through its own parameters Painter raises ValueError because the padding algorithm cannot be resolved, so padding must be supplied (exportParameters). Pipeline parameters override the map parameters. A map whose source channel the stack lacks is not written (Emission and Alpha on a stack without them).
packing.source: R-095: export-presets-ocio s34 and export-presets-legacy s37 (ValueError, padding), export-presets-ocio s35 (five files) and export-presets-legacy s38 (seven files) through a PNG 16 infinite rule; tunic-v10 export s2 (five files, config 7167a93e)

pending.what: Layout, names and per-map parameters confirmed by the admitted R-095 readbacks (export-presets-ocio s31, 12.2.0 and 12.1.5; export-presets-legacy s34) and corroborated by tunic-v10. Decoded pixel parity of every file against those goldens remains pending; $colorSpace under OCIO is admitted only for the cases src/export/plan.cpp names (an sRGB8 BaseColor, non-sRGB8 document channels, the PNG 16 Normal_OpenGL).
